# inspection-checklist

Embedded list as a phone inspection checklist: conditional fields, derived pass/fail, photos per row.

## README

# Inspection checklist

An embedded list as a phone inspection checklist: the inspector walks fixed rows,
enters a measurement or a result, and documents deviations with a finding and photos.

## What it shows

- **Conditional cells** (`src/entities/inspection-protocol.ts`): `visibleWhen` and
  `requiredWhen` on sub-fields and on top-level fields. The server enforces
  `requiredWhen` on create and update and answers with one `required` path per
  missing cell (`checkpoints.0.finding`, `condition`).
- **Pass/fail by range**: the derived `inRange` cell turns `measured`, `min` and `max`
  into `ok` or `not_ok` (bounds included). The server recomputes it, so a client-sent
  result never survives a value outside the range. `when` limits it to measurement rows;
  a check row keeps the result the inspector picked.
- **Photos per row**: an `images` sub-field. Upload with `entityType`, `fieldName` of the
  embedded list and `subField` of the photo cell; files are bound, tenant-checked and
  disposed like a top-level images field, always under the embedded list's field name.
- **Fixed rows**: `inspection-protocol:create-from-plan` copies label, kind and limits from
  a plan; the edit screen keeps those cells read-only and the row count fixed. It sets
  `layout.width: "full"` because the default form width pushes result, finding and photos
  behind horizontal scroll.

## Source

`src/feature.ts` wires the two entities, the handler and the screen. The integration test
covers every behavior above over real HTTP.

```ts
// Inspection Checklist Sample: Integration Test (conditional rows and derived result)
// Proves, through real HTTP: server-enforced requiredWhen on rows and top-level fields and
// the server-authoritative inRange cell.

import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import {
  admin,
  measurement,
  PROTOCOL_CREATE,
  PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
  useInspectionStack,
} from "./inspection-test-kit";

const kit = useInspectionStack();
const { pendingPhoto, createProtocol, checkpointsOf, storedResultOf } = kit;

describe("requiredWhen on rows", () => {
  test("a not_ok row without finding and photos is rejected with a path per cell", async () => {
    const error = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_CREATE,
      { checkpoints: [{ label: "Guard", kind: "check", result: "not_ok" }] },
      admin,
    );
    expect(error.httpStatus).toBe(400);
    expect(error.code).toBe("validation_error");
    const paths = (error.details as { fields: { path: string }[] }).fields.map((f) => f.path);
    expect(paths).toEqual(["checkpoints.0.finding", "checkpoints.0.photos"]);
  });

  test("a not_ok row with finding and photo is accepted", async () => {
    const photo = await pendingPhoto();
    const created = await createProtocol({
      checkpoints: [
        { label: "Guard", kind: "check", result: "not_ok", finding: "Cracked", photos: [photo] },
      ],
    });
    expect((await checkpointsOf(created.id))[0]).toMatchObject({
      result: "not_ok",
      finding: "Cracked",
      photos: [photo],
    });
  });
});

describe("inRange result", () => {
  test("the server derives not_ok above and ok inside the range, bounds included", async () => {
    const photo = await pendingPhoto();
    const outside = measurement(210, { finding: "Too high", photos: [photo] });
    expect(await storedResultOf(outside)).toBe("not_ok");
    expect(await storedResultOf(measurement(190))).toBe("ok");
    expect(await storedResultOf(measurement(180))).toBe("ok");
    expect(await storedResultOf(measurement(200))).toBe("ok");
  });

  test("a client-sent ok never survives a measured value outside the range", async () => {
    const photo = await pendingPhoto();
    const row = measurement(210, { result: "ok", finding: "Too high", photos: [photo] });
    expect(await storedResultOf(row)).toBe("not_ok");
  });

  test("requiredWhen sees the derived result, not the client-sent one", async () => {
    const error = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_CREATE,
      { checkpoints: [measurement(210, { result: "ok" })] },
      admin,
    );
    expect(error.httpStatus).toBe(400);
    const paths = (error.details as { fields: { path: string }[] }).fields.map((f) => f.path);
    expect(paths).toEqual(["checkpoints.0.finding", "checkpoints.0.photos"]);
  });

  test("a manual result on a check row is kept", async () => {
    const row = { label: "Guard", kind: "check", result: "ok" };
    expect(await storedResultOf(row)).toBe("ok");
  });
});

describe("requiredWhen on top-level fields", () => {
  test("with_condition needs a condition on create and on update", async () => {
    const onCreate = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_CREATE,
      { checkpoints: [], continuedOperation: "with_condition" },
      admin,
    );
    expect((onCreate.details as { fields: { path: string }[] }).fields[0]?.path).toBe("condition");

    const created = await createProtocol({ checkpoints: [], continuedOperation: "yes" });
    const onUpdate = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
      { id: created.id, version: 1, changes: { continuedOperation: "with_condition" } },
      admin,
    );
    expect(onUpdate.httpStatus).toBe(400);
    expect((onUpdate.details as { fields: { path: string }[] }).fields[0]?.path).toBe("condition");

    await kit.stack.http.writeOk(
      PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
      {
        id: created.id,
        version: 1,
        changes: { continuedOperation: "with_condition", condition: "Daylight only" },
      },
      admin,
    );
  });

  test("an unrelated update passes when the conditional fields are unchanged", async () => {
    const created = await createProtocol({
      checkpoints: [],
      continuedOperation: "with_condition",
      condition: "Daylight only",
    });
    await kit.stack.http.writeOk(
      PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
      { id: created.id, version: 1, changes: { measuringDevice: "Gauge 7" } },
      admin,
    );
  });
});
```

### src/__tests__/inspection-test-kit.ts

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, expect } from "bun:test";
import { createConfigFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/config";
import { createFileFoundationFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/file-foundation";
import {
  createFilesFeature,
  createInMemoryFileProvider,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/files";
import { createTestUser, testTenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import {
  buildMultipartBody,
  patchFileInstanceofForBunTest,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/helpers";
import {
  setupTestStack,
  type TestStack,
  unsafeCreateEntityTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { inspectionPlanEntity } from "../entities/inspection-plan";
import { inspectionProtocolEntity } from "../entities/inspection-protocol";
import { inspectionChecklistFeature } from "../feature";

export const PROTOCOL_CREATE = "inspection-checklist:write:inspection-protocol:create";
export const PROTOCOL_UPDATE = "inspection-checklist:write:inspection-protocol:update";
export const PROTOCOL_DETAIL = "inspection-checklist:query:inspection-protocol:detail";
export const PLAN_CREATE = "inspection-checklist:write:inspection-plan:create";
export const CREATE_FROM_PLAN = "inspection-checklist:write:inspection-protocol:create-from-plan";

const JPEG_BYTES = new Uint8Array([0xff, 0xd8, 0xff, 0xe0, ...Array(10).fill(0)]);
const PDF_BYTES = new TextEncoder().encode("%PDF-1.4\n%test\n");

export const UploadFiles = {
  jpeg: { name: "pump.jpg", type: "image/jpeg", bytes: JPEG_BYTES },
  pdf: { name: "report.pdf", type: "application/pdf", bytes: PDF_BYTES },
} as const;

const tenantId = testTenantId(1);
export const admin = createTestUser({ id: 1, tenantId, roles: ["Admin"] });
export const inspector = createTestUser({ id: 4, tenantId, roles: ["Inspector"] });
export const viewer = createTestUser({ id: 2, tenantId, roles: ["Viewer"] });
export const otherTenantAdmin = createTestUser({
  id: 3,
  tenantId: testTenantId(2),
  roles: ["Admin"],
});

type User = typeof admin;
export type Row = Record<string, unknown>;
type Protocol = { readonly id: string; readonly version: number };

export function measurement(measured: number | undefined, extra: Row = {}): Row {
  return { label: "Pressure", kind: "measurement", min: 180, max: 200, measured, ...extra };
}

export function useInspectionStack() {
  let stack: TestStack;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    patchFileInstanceofForBunTest();
    stack = await setupTestStack({
      features: [
        createConfigFeature(),
        createFileFoundationFeature(),
        createFilesFeature(),
        inspectionChecklistFeature,
      ],
      files: { storageProvider: createInMemoryFileProvider() },
    });
    await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, inspectionPlanEntity, "inspection-plan");
    await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, inspectionProtocolEntity, "inspection-protocol");
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await stack.cleanup();
  });

  type UploadTarget = {
    entityId?: string;
    fieldName?: string;
    subField?: string;
    file?: (typeof UploadFiles)[keyof typeof UploadFiles];
  };

  async function upload(
    asUser: User,
    target: UploadTarget = { fieldName: "checkpoints", subField: "photos" },
  ) {
    const fd = new FormData();
    fd.append("entityType", "inspection-protocol");
    if (target.fieldName !== undefined) fd.append("fieldName", target.fieldName);
    if (target.subField !== undefined) fd.append("subField", target.subField);
    if (target.entityId !== undefined) fd.append("entityId", target.entityId);
    const file = target.file ?? UploadFiles.jpeg;
    fd.append("file", new File([Buffer.from(file.bytes)], file.name, { type: file.type }));
    const { body, contentType } = await buildMultipartBody(fd);
    const token = await stack.jwt.sign(asUser);
    const res = await stack.app.request("/api/files", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "Content-Type": contentType },
      body,
    });
    const json = (await res.json()) as { id?: string };
    return { status: res.status, id: json.id ?? "" };
  }

  async function pendingPhoto(asUser: User = admin): Promise<string> {
    const { status, id } = await upload(asUser);
    expect(status).toBe(201);
    return id;
  }

  async function pendingDocument(asUser: User = admin): Promise<string> {
    const { status, id } = await upload(asUser, {
      fieldName: "checkpoints",
      subField: "documents",
      file: UploadFiles.pdf,
    });
    expect(status).toBe(201);
    return id;
  }

  async function fileStatus(fileId: string, asUser: User = admin): Promise<number> {
    const token = await stack.jwt.sign(asUser);
    const res = await stack.app.request(`/api/files/${fileId}`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    });
    return res.status;
  }

  async function createProtocol(payload: Row, asUser: User = admin): Promise<Protocol> {
    return stack.http.writeOk<Protocol>(PROTOCOL_CREATE, payload, asUser);
  }

  async function checkpointsOf(id: string): Promise<Row[]> {
    const detail = await stack.http.queryOk<{ checkpoints: Row[] }>(PROTOCOL_DETAIL, { id }, admin);
    return detail.checkpoints;
  }

  async function storedResultOf(row: Row): Promise<unknown> {
    const created = await createProtocol({ checkpoints: [row] });
    return (await checkpointsOf(created.id))[0]?.["result"];
  }

  return {
    get stack() {
      return stack;
    },
    upload,
    pendingPhoto,
    pendingDocument,
    fileStatus,
    createProtocol,
    checkpointsOf,
    storedResultOf,
  };
}
```

### src/__tests__/photos.integration.test.ts

```ts
// Inspection Checklist Sample: Integration Test (photos in a row, create-from-plan)
// Proves, through real HTTP: pending upload with `subField`, binding under the embedded
// field name, read access, tenant isolation, disposal and copying rows from a plan.

import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { selectMany } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
import { fileRefsTable } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/files";
import {
  admin,
  CREATE_FROM_PLAN,
  otherTenantAdmin,
  PLAN_CREATE,
  PROTOCOL_CREATE,
  PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
  type Row,
  useInspectionStack,
  viewer,
} from "./inspection-test-kit";

const kit = useInspectionStack();
const { upload, pendingPhoto, fileStatus, createProtocol, checkpointsOf } = kit;

describe("photos inside a row", () => {
  test("a pending upload is bound to the protocol under the top-level field name", async () => {
    const photo = await pendingPhoto();
    const created = await createProtocol({
      checkpoints: [
        { label: "Guard", kind: "check", result: "not_ok", finding: "Cracked", photos: [photo] },
      ],
    });

    const [ref] = await selectMany(kit.stack.db, fileRefsTable, { id: photo });
    expect(ref).toMatchObject({
      entityType: "inspection-protocol",
      entityId: created.id,
      fieldName: "checkpoints",
    });
  });

  test("reads: owner 200, other tenant 404, same tenant without read access denied", async () => {
    const photo = await pendingPhoto();
    await createProtocol({
      checkpoints: [
        { label: "Guard", kind: "check", result: "not_ok", finding: "Cracked", photos: [photo] },
      ],
    });
    expect(await fileStatus(photo, admin)).toBe(200);
    expect(await fileStatus(photo, otherTenantAdmin)).toBe(404);
    expect(await fileStatus(photo, viewer)).toBe(404);
  });

  test("an upload against an existing record binds the file at once", async () => {
    const created = await createProtocol({ checkpoints: [{ label: "Guard", kind: "check" }] });
    const { status, id } = await upload(admin, {
      entityId: created.id,
      fieldName: "checkpoints",
      subField: "photos",
    });
    expect(status).toBe(201);
    const [ref] = await selectMany(kit.stack.db, fileRefsTable, { id });
    expect(ref).toMatchObject({ entityId: created.id, fieldName: "checkpoints" });
  });

  test("file ids from another tenant or another protocol are rejected", async () => {
    const foreign = await pendingPhoto(otherTenantAdmin);
    const row = (photo: string): Row => ({
      label: "Guard",
      kind: "check",
      result: "not_ok",
      finding: "Cracked",
      photos: [photo],
    });
    const foreignTenant = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_CREATE,
      { checkpoints: [row(foreign)] },
      admin,
    );
    expect([foreignTenant.httpStatus, foreignTenant.code]).toEqual([400, "validation_error"]);

    const own = await pendingPhoto();
    await createProtocol({ checkpoints: [row(own)] });
    const otherProtocol = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_CREATE,
      { checkpoints: [row(own)] },
      admin,
    );
    expect([otherProtocol.httpStatus, otherProtocol.code]).toEqual([400, "validation_error"]);
  });

  test("removing a photo from a row disposes its file", async () => {
    const keep = await pendingPhoto();
    const drop = await pendingPhoto();
    const row = (photos: string[]): Row => ({
      label: "Guard",
      kind: "check",
      result: "not_ok",
      finding: "Cracked",
      photos,
    });
    const created = await createProtocol({ checkpoints: [row([keep, drop])] });

    await kit.stack.http.writeOk(
      PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
      { id: created.id, version: 1, changes: { checkpoints: [row([keep])] } },
      admin,
    );

    expect(await fileStatus(keep)).toBe(200);
    expect(await fileStatus(drop)).toBe(404);
  });

  test("a subField that is not a file sub-field or not a plain name is a 400", async () => {
    for (const subField of ["label", "a.b", "../x"]) {
      const { status } = await upload(admin, { fieldName: "checkpoints", subField });
      expect(status).toBe(400);
    }
  });
});

describe("create-from-plan", () => {
  test("copies label, kind and limits and leaves the result empty", async () => {
    const plan = await kit.stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
      PLAN_CREATE,
      {
        name: "Monthly pump check",
        checkpoints: [
          { label: "Guard fitted", kind: "check" },
          { label: "Pressure", kind: "measurement", min: 180, max: 200 },
        ],
      },
      admin,
    );

    const created = await kit.stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
      CREATE_FROM_PLAN,
      { planId: plan.id },
      admin,
    );

    expect(await checkpointsOf(created.id)).toEqual([
      { label: "Guard fitted", kind: "check" },
      { label: "Pressure", kind: "measurement", min: 180, max: 200 },
    ]);
  });
});
```

### src/__tests__/sub-field-rules.integration.test.ts

```ts
// Inspection Checklist Sample: Integration Test (rules of single cells on save)
// Proves, through real HTTP: a cell's write access is enforced when the record is saved, and a
// file only lands in a file cell whose accept list it fits.

import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import {
  admin,
  inspector,
  PROTOCOL_CREATE,
  PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
  type Row,
  useInspectionStack,
} from "./inspection-test-kit";

const kit = useInspectionStack();

// The same denial a top-level field with a write rule gets.
const OWNERSHIP_DENIED = [422, "errors.ownershipDenied"];

const check = (extra: Row = {}): Row => ({ label: "Guard", kind: "check", ...extra });

describe("write access of a single cell", () => {
  test("a user without the role cannot set the cell, on create or update", async () => {
    const created = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_CREATE,
      { checkpoints: [check({ approvedBy: "Me" })] },
      inspector,
    );
    expect([created.httpStatus, created.i18nKey]).toEqual(OWNERSHIP_DENIED);

    const protocol = await kit.createProtocol({ checkpoints: [check()] }, inspector);
    const updated = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
      { id: protocol.id, version: 1, changes: { checkpoints: [check({ approvedBy: "Me" })] } },
      inspector,
    );
    expect([updated.httpStatus, updated.i18nKey]).toEqual(OWNERSHIP_DENIED);
    expect(await kit.checkpointsOf(protocol.id)).toEqual([check()]);
  });

  test("the same user may save rows that leave the cell as it is", async () => {
    const protocol = await kit.createProtocol({ checkpoints: [check({ approvedBy: "Boss" })] });
    await kit.stack.http.writeOk(
      PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
      {
        id: protocol.id,
        version: 1,
        changes: { checkpoints: [check({ approvedBy: "Boss", label: "Guard fitted" })] },
      },
      inspector,
    );
    expect(await kit.checkpointsOf(protocol.id)).toEqual([
      check({ approvedBy: "Boss", label: "Guard fitted" }),
    ]);
  });

  test("changing or clearing the cell on an existing row is denied, removing the row too", async () => {
    const protocol = await kit.createProtocol({ checkpoints: [check({ approvedBy: "Boss" })] });
    for (const checkpoints of [[check({ approvedBy: "Me" })], [check()], []]) {
      const denied = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
        PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
        { id: protocol.id, version: 1, changes: { checkpoints } },
        inspector,
      );
      expect([denied.httpStatus, denied.i18nKey]).toEqual(OWNERSHIP_DENIED);
    }
    await kit.stack.http.writeOk(
      PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
      { id: protocol.id, version: 1, changes: { checkpoints: [check({ approvedBy: "Me" })] } },
      admin,
    );
  });
});

describe("a file only lands in a cell it fits", () => {
  test("a pdf uploaded to the loose cell is rejected in the photos cell", async () => {
    const pdf = await kit.pendingDocument();
    const denied = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_CREATE,
      {
        checkpoints: [
          check({ result: "not_ok", finding: "Cracked", photos: [pdf], documents: [pdf] }),
        ],
      },
      admin,
    );
    expect([denied.httpStatus, denied.code]).toEqual([422, "unprocessable"]);
  });

  test("the same pdf is accepted where it was uploaded", async () => {
    const pdf = await kit.pendingDocument();
    const created = await kit.createProtocol({ checkpoints: [check({ documents: [pdf] })] });
    expect(await kit.checkpointsOf(created.id)).toEqual([check({ documents: [pdf] })]);
  });

  test("moving a stored pdf from the documents cell to the photos cell is rejected", async () => {
    const pdf = await kit.pendingDocument();
    const created = await kit.createProtocol({ checkpoints: [check({ documents: [pdf] })] });
    const denied = await kit.stack.http.writeErr(
      PROTOCOL_UPDATE,
      {
        id: created.id,
        version: 1,
        changes: {
          checkpoints: [check({ result: "not_ok", finding: "Cracked", photos: [pdf] })],
        },
      },
      admin,
    );
    expect([denied.httpStatus, denied.code]).toEqual([422, "unprocessable"]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { buildEntityTable } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
```

```ts
import { buildEntityTable } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
import {
  createEmbeddedListField,
  createEntity,
  createSelectField,
  createTextField,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";

const isMeasurement = { field: "kind", eq: "measurement" } as const;
const isNotOk = { field: "result", eq: "not_ok" } as const;

export const inspectionProtocolEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_sample_inspection_protocols",
  fields: {
    measuringDevice: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data" }),
    checkpoints: createEmbeddedListField(
      {
        label: { type: "text", required: true },
        kind: { type: "select", options: ["check", "measurement"], required: true },
        min: { type: "number", visibleWhen: isMeasurement },
        max: { type: "number", visibleWhen: isMeasurement },
        measured: { type: "number", visibleWhen: isMeasurement },
        result: {
          type: "select",
          options: ["ok", "not_ok"],
          display: "radio",
          optionTones: { ok: "ok", not_ok: "bad" },
        },
        finding: { type: "text", visibleWhen: isNotOk, requiredWhen: isNotOk },
        photos: {
          type: "images",
          capture: "environment",
          maxCount: 5,
          accept: ["jpg", "jpeg", "png"],
          visibleWhen: isNotOk,
          requiredWhen: isNotOk,
        },
        documents: { type: "files", maxCount: 3 },
        approvedBy: { type: "text", access: { write: ["Admin"] } },
      },
      {
        personal: false,
        reason: "is_business_data",
        derived: {
          result: {
            op: "inRange",
            from: ["measured", "min", "max"],
            inside: "ok",
            outside: "not_ok",
            when: isMeasurement,
          },
        },
      },
    ),
    continuedOperation: createSelectField({
      options: ["yes", "with_condition", "no"],
      display: "radio",
      optionTones: { yes: "ok", with_condition: "warn", no: "bad" },
    }),
    condition: createTextField({
      personal: false,
      reason: "is_business_data",
      visibleWhen: { field: "continuedOperation", eq: "with_condition" },
      requiredWhen: { field: "continuedOperation", eq: "with_condition" },
    }),
  },
});

export const inspectionProtocolTable = buildEntityTable(
  "inspection-protocol",
  inspectionProtocolEntity,
);
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// Inspection Checklist Sample
// Shows: an embedded list as a phone inspection checklist.
//   - visibleWhen / requiredWhen on cells and top-level fields (server-enforced)
//   - a derived pass/fail cell (inRange) that the server recomputes
//   - an images cell per row, uploaded with the `subField` multipart part
//   - fixed rows copied from a plan, only the result cells stay editable

import { defineFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { inspectionPlanEntity } from "./entities/inspection-plan";
import { inspectionProtocolEntity } from "./entities/inspection-protocol";
import { createFromPlan } from "./handlers/create-from-plan.write";
import { inspectionProtocolEditScreen } from "./screens/inspection-protocol-edit.screen";

export { inspectionPlanEntity } from "./entities/inspection-plan";
export { inspectionProtocolEntity } from "./entities/inspection-protocol";

const inspectorAccess = { access: { roles: ["Admin", "Inspector"] } } as const;

export const inspectionChecklistFeature = defineFeature("inspection-checklist", (r) => {
  r.requires({ features: ["files"] });

  r.crud("inspection-plan", inspectionPlanEntity, {
    write: inspectorAccess,
    read: inspectorAccess,
  });
  r.crud("inspection-protocol", inspectionProtocolEntity, {
    write: inspectorAccess,
    read: inspectorAccess,
  });
  r.writeHandler(createFromPlan);

  r.screen(inspectionProtocolEditScreen);
});
```

### src/handlers/create-from-plan.write.ts

```ts
import { createEntityExecutor, defineWriteHandler } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { failNotFound } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/errors";
import { z } from "zod";
import { inspectionPlanEntity } from "../entities/inspection-plan";
import { inspectionProtocolEntity } from "../entities/inspection-protocol";

const { executor: planExecutor } = createEntityExecutor("inspection-plan", inspectionPlanEntity);
const { executor: protocolExecutor } = createEntityExecutor(
  "inspection-protocol",
  inspectionProtocolEntity,
);

const planRows = z.array(
  z.object({
    label: z.string(),
    kind: z.enum(["check", "measurement"]),
    min: z.number().optional(),
    max: z.number().optional(),
  }),
);

// Copies only the plan's fixed columns; result, finding and photos stay empty for the inspector.
export const createFromPlan = defineWriteHandler({
  name: "inspection-protocol:create-from-plan",
  schema: z.object({ planId: z.uuid() }),
  access: { roles: ["Admin", "Inspector"] },
  handler: async (event, ctx) => {
    const plan = await planExecutor.detail({ id: event.payload.planId }, event.user, ctx.db);
    if (!plan) return failNotFound("inspection-plan", event.payload.planId);
    const checkpoints = planRows.parse(plan["checkpoints"]).map(({ label, kind, min, max }) => ({
      label,
      kind,
      ...(min !== undefined ? { min } : {}),
      ...(max !== undefined ? { max } : {}),
    }));
    return protocolExecutor.create({ checkpoints }, event.user, ctx.db);
  },
});
```

```ts
import type { EntityEditScreenDefinition } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";

export const inspectionProtocolEditScreen: EntityEditScreenDefinition = {
  id: "inspection-protocol-edit",
  type: "entityEdit",
  entity: "inspection-protocol",
  layout: {
    width: "full",
    sections: [
      {
        columns: 1,
        fields: [
          "measuringDevice",
          {
            field: "checkpoints",
            embeddedList: {
              readOnlyCells: ["label", "kind", "min", "max"],
              cardHiddenCells: ["kind"],
              fixedRows: true,
            },
          },
        ],
      },
      { columns: 1, fields: ["continuedOperation", "condition"] },
    ],
  },
};
```
